summary: The manuscript presents CAPSET-F3-GROWTH-CERT-1.0, a companion formal-verification and exact-arithmetic audit artifact for ZeHua Lu's preprint arXiv:2611.30110 (which claims Lambda > 2.229206468135675727981404 for the ternary cap-set growth constant). Combining 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice) with a zero-floating-point Python verifier over Z, Q, and F3 across 16 certificates (C01-C16) and 63 deterministic tests, the work independently verifies the finite cap-set seeds, two-color slot axioms, port/score synchronization and companion-path exclusions, zero-fiber pooling and spoke-star geometry, exact rational Eq. (A.1) filling-price checks, and verbatim Round 9 28-digit integer Perron bounds and 1000th-power Eq. (A.6) integer bracket. The scope boundary omitting Appendix C pivot tables and the 352-row 14-step DP is candidly disclosed, and all equations, tables, figures, and worked witnesses in the PDF are mathematically sound and mutually consistent, with only minor presentation/precision notes.
weaknesses: The Abstract ('proving Lambda > 2.229206...') and Worked Witness 4 ('certifying Lambda > 2.229206...') slightly overstate unconditional certification when read in isolation, since certification of the asymptotic cap-set bound remains conditional on Lu [4]'s unverified Appendix C pivot tables and 352-row 14-step DP producing P0, P1, P2 (as disclosed in Section 1).
Proposition 1 (Verifier Soundness) is stated informally rather than proven as a formal equivalence between the Python AST-restricted checker and the Lean 4 kernel semantics.
The 4-page PDF omits the verbatim 28-digit matrices P0, P1, P2 and Lean/Python source listings, deferring full artifact inspection to the cited GitHub repository.
